answers.core:
currently it's possible to detect controls on the left and on the right of the current control. But no way to find the controls on the top or the bottom relatively to current control. I think this is a core feature that is missing.

**Note:** engine does this navigation out of the box, so I think that the least we could do is just to expose some existing APIs so that the users could build the navigation system themselves. The next evolution of the solution is to actually support multiple focuses, but I do not want to bring this topic up in this discussion as it requires more work and more analysis than just exposing a couple of functions.
answers.workaround: no workaround that I know of

title: Expose a method to get the next control to be focused based on direction of the input
